name: Gamzee Makara
source:
Gamzee Makara, also known by his Trollian handle terminallyCapricious, is one of the trolls.

He appears to be the troll equivalent of a Juggalo. Though he swears very frequently, he is a very good-natured and laidback troll. He is a supportive friend and will make sacrifices at the request of a friend. Because of his magnanimous personality, he will frequently act as an advisor or even a therapist to his friends if they are experiencing emotional stress, though his usual counseling involves suggesting that they wait for a miracle. Among the things that litter his bedroom are bottles of Faygo, an oversized unicycle, a laptop, juggling clubs, pie tins, and several bike horns. He has an addiction to eating a mind-altering substance called sopor slime.

His associated zodiac sign is Capricorn. He is of purple blood caste.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Gamzee_Makara]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
